Bone Dragon / Hybrid Elemental Dragon
Parentage: Terrax + Leviathans
Important family relationships: Son of Terrax and Leviathans; protective older brother of Ife; related to Rahim, Gaius and Shailara through shared parents.
Primary element/power: Bone — synthesis of Earth and Water.
Signature appearance: Long black hair, warm brown complexion, amber-gold eyes, ivory living bone armor and Indian-inspired clothing.

Family is something one actively maintains.
Love: Love is demonstrated through action.
Death: Even the strongest structure eventually returns to the world.
Magic: Magic should be understood before it is wielded recklessly.
Religion/spirituality: TBD.
Authority: Respect should be earned.
Strength: True strength is the ability to endure without abandoning responsibility.
Weakness: Weakness is not failure; refusing to acknowledge damage is dangerous.
Good and evil: Actions matter more than titles.
Birth of Ruchika - Terrax and Leviathans produce a child whose elemental synthesis manifests as Bone.
Early Development - Ruchika discovers that his Bone is living elemental structure created from Earth-derived minerals and Water-derived life and adaptability.
Skeletal Mastery - Ruchika learns Skeletal Replication
allowing him to generate and shape additional living bone.
Density Mastery - Ruchika develops the ability to alter the density and flexibility of his constructs.
Instant Mending Development - Ruchika's generated Bone develops the ability to reconnect and restore shattered structures.
Rise as a Craftsman - Ruchika becomes known for applying elemental power to building
